A '''little man''' once worked as an [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. The little man supplied Vader with information regarding [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] veiled attempts to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Vader's son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].
